task.description: Full gap-check of test/letflow/routers/req196_audit_route_test.exs (ELIXIR-DEV's first pass, REVIEWER already spot-checked AC1/AC2) plus test/letflow/routers/req078_supporting_routes_test.exs's fixture swap, against all 9 acceptance criteria in docs/requirements.yaml REQ-196. Full rationale in handoffs/WF02-REQ196-20260830/test-designer-gap-analysis.md (see that file for the per-AC verdict table, the response to each of the 10 specific checks the orchestrating agent asked for, and the verification transcript). Summary: all 9 ACs already had genuine, non-tautological coverage from ELIXIR-DEV's first pass -- AC1's seeding via Letflow.Audit.insert_entry/3 is REQ-195's own real write API (not a hand-inserted fake row), consistent with REQ-196's own non-goal of not touching REQ-195's capture logic, and with the identical pre-existing idiom in req078_supporting_routes_test.exs. The pre-existing cursor-round-trip test already exercises the NEW (timestamp, id) seek-pair scheme (not the old global_seq scheme), and actor_id UUID-cast validation was already both implemented and tested. Genuine gaps found and filled (10 new tests, matching exactly the edge-case list step-03's own task.acceptance_criteria named): (1) resource_id filter -- implemented (where_resource_id/2) but never tested; added filter-to-one / omit-returns-all pair. (2) empty audit_entries table -- split_list_page/2's []/next_cursor/2's []-clause never exercised; added a zero-row test asserting items:[]/count:0/next_cursor:nil. (3) page_size exact boundary -- only page_size<row_count (has_more:true) was tested; added the has_more:false side (rows == page_size exactly). (4) from/to time-range filter, including from>to -> 422 -- never tested at all; added inclusive-bounds test (reading a real cutoff timestamp between two seeded inserts, 5ms Process.sleep between them to guarantee distinct microsecond timestamps, matching the sandbox_pool_test.exs precedent -- not asserting anything about wall-clock time itself) plus a from>to 422 test. (5) malformed cursor variants beyond the one already-tested base64-garbage case -- added a wrong-endpoint-prefix cursor (hits Pagination.decode_cursor/4's :wrong_endpoint branch) and a right-prefix-but-malformed-inner-payload cursor (hits cursor_seek_from_cursor/1's own parse failure, a distinct code path). No existing test weakened, skipped, or removed; grep confirms zero @tag :skip/:pending anywhere in either file.
